meta.title: Chimney Cap Installation Toronto | Northmark Chimney
meta.description: Chimney cap installation in Toronto & the GTA. Caps measured to your flue keep rain, snow, animals and debris out. Free inspection, price before work.

hero.p: An open flue lets in rain, snow, leaves and animals. A cap sized to your chimney keeps them out — single-flue, multi-flue or custom, measured on the roof, not guessed from the driveway.
hero.t-2: Measured on the roof — to your flue size and count
hero.t-3: Old or rusted cap — removed and taken away
hero.t-4: Screened — to keep animals and debris out

signs.h2: Signs You Need A Chimney Cap
signs.p: A cap is the simplest protection a chimney can get.
signs.p-2: The flue is open to the sky, so rain, snow and debris go straight down.
signs.p-3: Rust and storm damage let water and animals through.
signs.p-4: Scratching or nesting sounds usually mean the flue is open. If something is nesting, we deal with that first.
signs.p-5: Rain coming straight down the flue often means a missing or damaged cap.
signs.p-6: If debris is landing in the firebox, it is coming in from the top.
signs.p-7: Not sure which one you’re seeing? That is what the free inspection is for. Book it here or call {{site.phone}}.

faq.q: Do I really need a chimney cap?
faq.p-2: If the flue is open to the sky, water, snow, animals and debris are getting in. A cap is the simplest protection a chimney can get.
faq.q-2: Which cap is right for my chimney?
faq.p-3: It depends on your flue size, the number of flues and the fuel. We measure on the roof and recommend the right fit — single, multi-flue or custom.
faq.q-3: Will a cap stop squirrels and raccoons?
faq.p-4: A properly installed cap with screening keeps animals out. If something is already nesting inside, we deal with that first.
faq.p-5: A correctly sized cap won’t hurt draft — a wrong one can. That is why we size to the flue instead of guessing.
faq.p-6: Usually a single short visit once the right cap is on hand. We confirm timing when we call you back.
